explanatory_strength.rationale: Owner-earnings path remains clear after round-two re-read: high subscription mix, light maintenance capex, large FCF. Reinvestment quality still hinges on whether AI spend preserves owner cash growth.

evidence_sufficiency.rationale: Research response only partially answers buyback sustainability and leaves Firefly attach unresolved. Filing FCF quality is strong; incremental AI ROI evidence is not.

downside_control.rationale: Balance sheet can fund the franchise through a de-rating, but debt-funded buybacks raise the bar if FCF/share drifts toward $18. Equity risk remains multiple and growth, not solvency.

return_vs_alternatives.rationale: ~10× FY2025 owner cash is reasonable for quality only if mid-teens growth persists. Contract 15.8% is hurdle-clearing, not uniquely cheap versus other reinvestment compounders.

claims.claim: FY2025 FCF $9.85B from $10.03B OCF less $179M capex still evidences high owner-earnings conversion in the frozen packet.
Research response marks buyback sustainability under an $18 FCF/share stress as unresolved judgment despite filing debt/cash facts.

strongest_counter_explanation: Aggressive buybacks at these FCF levels are owner-aligned capital return, and AI spend is maintenance of a wonderful business rather than a value trap.
most_important_missing_fact: Verified incremental return on AI/Firefly reinvestment versus reserved spend.
falsifiers: Trailing four-quarter free cash flow per share below $18.00
Buybacks falling below SBC for four consecutive quarters while net debt rises
Subscription revenue mix falling materially below 90%
specialist_findings: Buffett/Weschler round two: quality remains high; reinvestment proof incomplete after research loop. Watch until AI attach or FCF/share trajectory clarifies.
